title: The check that could hang
subtitle: What a security review found before a release
intro: This is the story of a check that could hang, and how it was caught before anyone got it.

checked.found: one character could match two ways
checked.notes: First we looked at the pattern itself. One character could match in two ways inside a repeated group.
Then we measured it. 20 hidden characters took 108 ms, and 26 took 4355 ms.
And we checked what had gone out. Version 0.4.0 was merged, but npm still showed 0.3.0.

found.headline: A long hidden run could hang the check
found.line: Each few extra characters multiplied the time
found.notes: So a crafted run of hidden characters could hang whatever reads a storyboard, because the time multiplied as the run grew.

unsure.what: Whether other patterns have the same flaw
unsure.notes: We are not sure no other pattern has this flaw, because only this one was measured.

next: A timed test holds the cost
closing: The fix went in before the release, so nothing with this bug reached npm.
